pages.aboutText: Pro-Optics is a specialist shop for professional optics. We help you choose a thermal imager, a sight or a night vision device for a specific job: hunting, security, military use.
pages.aboutMilitaryP1: We believe good optics should be within reach of those defending our country. Serving members of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, the National Guard, the Border Guard, volunteers and territorial defence fighters get separate, favourable terms across the whole range — thermal imagers, thermal sights, night vision devices, monoculars and binoculars.
pages.aboutMilitaryP2: The military discount is permanent and applies to devices from the leading makers. To claim it, contact us before ordering and confirm your status — a combat participant certificate, a military ID or a corresponding document from your unit. Our consultants will help pick a device for the actual task: observation, reconnaissance, perimeter security or night watch.
pages.aboutMilitaryP3: We are proud to be of use to our defenders. Fast Nova Poshta delivery across Ukraine, a warranty on every device and expert advice — that is what we offer to everyone standing guard over our freedom.
pages.deliveryText: We deliver with Nova Poshta across Ukraine. Payment: online (Monobank / LiqPay / WayForPay) or on delivery.
pages.warrantyText: Help with setup, firmware and after-sales service.
